in_arabic.name: Fardanah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Fardanah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. From the Arabic root 'faradana' meaning 'to be exalted, honored, or distinguished.' This name carries the deep spiritual significance of being lifted up and celebrated in the sight of Allah.
